# WO-209: Safety and families hero gutters (audit A07/A08)
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-042; worktree ready)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: web-builder
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: CP-45 / WO-204 audit A07, A08 / CLAUDE-042, CLAUDE-044

## Goal
At phone widths the /safety/ and /families/ hero heading and art touch the screen edge. Put each hero inside the page-local wrap so it gets the same side gutter as the rest of the page.

## Acceptance criteria
- At 320/360/390 CSS px the hero heading, lead and art have >=16px inline gutter; no horizontal scroll at any width.
- Keep the restored approved art on /safety/ (`sections/safety-local`, label "Your details are stored on your computer, not in the cloud.") and all copy unchanged.
- No CTA-ink or link-target work (WO-208 did it). Keep line 1 `---`, every id, real hrefs, no inline styles/scripts.

## Allowed paths
- `web/src/pages/safety/index.astro`
- `web/src/pages/families/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_audit_trust_pages_followup.py` (new; asserts gutters only)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build && pnpm check`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_web*.py tests/codex/` (ALL must pass; no known failures remain)
- `ruff check tests/codex`
